definitions.partial_sum: R_n(Y)=sum_{m=2}^Y ((1-Lambda(m))/m) L_{n-1}^{(1)}(log m), in natural m-order.
definitions.target: S_n=S_{2Lambda}(n), the natural-order target value in the frozen Coffey coordinate.

statement.theorem_local: For every fixed n and cutoff Y for which the frozen definitions apply, (-S_n)_+ <= Q_n(Y)+D_n(Y).
statement.corollary_scale: For any positive scale g_n and cutoffs Y_n, if Q_n(Y_n)=O(g_n) and D_n(Y_n)=o(g_n) (or O(g_n)), then (-S_n)_+=O(g_n).
statement.route_interpretation: An unconditional complement theorem that makes D_n(Y_n) small does not by itself certify that the strict-cut running-excursion obligation is genuinely weaker than one-sided endpoint downside control. Once D_n is certified small, controlling Q_n is already sufficient for the endpoint downside at essentially the same scale; Q_n may be strictly stronger because it controls all earlier negative excursions.
not_claimed: No converse Q_n=O(g_n) from endpoint downside is proved.
No TARGET_DOMAIN arithmetic hostile pair or strictness theorem is proved.
No claim that one-sided S_n downside control alone is equivalent to RH is made.
No Li coefficient positivity theorem, all-index positivity proof, or RH theorem is claimed.
No R5 tail theorem is promoted beyond its existing proposal/shadow status.

proof.reason: The maximum defining Q_n(Y) includes M=Y, hence (-R_n(Y))_+ <= Q_n(Y); this implies R_n(Y) >= -Q_n(Y).
Substitute Q_n(Y_n)=O(g_n), D_n(Y_n)=o(g_n) or O(g_n) into step 4.

counterexample_first_falsification.tested_interpretation: A strict cut plus a small unconditional complement automatically yields a genuinely weaker running-excursion intermediate.
counterexample_first_falsification.witness: The deterministic implication shows Q_n plus a small complement dominates the exact one-sided endpoint downside. Therefore small-complement control cannot itself be used as the missing strict-reduction witness for Q_n.
counterexample_first_falsification.scope: Only the running-negative-excursion family Q_n and this one-sided endpoint coordinate. Different non-extremal internal statistics remain open.
